Self-contained: each feature carries its own difficulty colour, so it renders correctly on a fresh viewer load with no pipeline, DB, or localStorage dependency.

properties.name: Descension
properties.description: A mild descent onto a dirt flat. The work's at the bottom: a deep, eroded rut with a tree root sitting square in the line.

properties.name: 1 Launchpad
properties.description: Packed dirt and an easy climb to start. At Area 51 the tread turns to loose rock and the ride gets choppy. Still easy, just rougher.

properties.name: Convergence
properties.description: An easy spur off Launchpad, bending toward the buggy side of the park. Mountain runoff gathers here and drains into Battle Creek. That's the convergence it's named for.

properties.name: Major Tom
properties.description: Looks easy, and that's the catch. A starter rig or anything low on clearance can get hung up the second you stop paying attention.

properties.name: Ground Control
properties.description: Up and down, over and over. A short, rolling run. Rock shows up in clusters, but none of it's hard to clear.

properties.name: Lifeform
properties.description: A quiet uphill connector. Small rock, some exposed roots, a few bends, then it feeds back out onto Trail 3.
A short loop with many rock and ledge obstacles that challenge drivers to negotiate angles and clearance. Passable by modified Jeeps and Trucks.

properties.name: Ascension
properties.description: A hill climb. Dry, anything makes it. Wet, it gets greasy fast.

properties.name: Little Dipper
properties.description: A full loop back to its own start, with feeders off to harder trails. Flat and clean almost the whole way, barely an obstacle on it.
